jobs.title: Senior Strategist
jobs.description_text: As a Senior Strategist on Stand Together’s Strategic Analysis team, you will be a trusted advisor to our issue teams on their hardest questions. Our team builds the research, insights, and standards behind our Priority Initiatives. These are the teams that lead our work on issues like Unleashing Economic Growth and Mobility and Bridging Divides. You will work embedded with one of them, from early strategy to finished materials. You will use research, our internal knowledge, and experts across the organization to build points of view and strategies. Then you will write them up so our staff and stakeholders can act on them. You will bring rigor to the issue leader’s hardest questions. The issue leader stays accountable for the strategy. This role fits a senior individual contributor who thinks like an advisor. You stay calm in ambiguity. You can turn a lot of data and information into one clear point of view. And you like helping other teams turn strategy into impact.

The project supports Canada’s Arctic sovereignty and continental defence, including interoperability with the North Atlantic Treaty Organization (NATO) and North American Aerospace Defense Command (NORAD).

The position does not directly manage segment Program Managers, who remain within their respective organizations and coordinate extensively with the PMO, However, the role establishes program management standards, methodologies, reporting requirements, and governance practices across the enterprise. You will design, implement, and validate algorithms and optimization methods, contribute to performance assessments, and guide architectural decisions that support the constellation's success. jobs.title: Senior QA Engineer Position for Xsolla's Smart Wallet in Web3
jobs.description_text: ABOUT YOU We are looking for a Senior QA Engineer who has tested real on-chain products — the contracts and the transactions, not only the web app in front of them. You will own quality for Xsolla's smart wallet on Xsolla ZK , our Ethereum-compatible ZK rollup: the wallet players use to hold, receive and send tokens and in-game items, signing in with the account they already have. The work runs on both sides of the chain. On the backend, you will confirm that a wallet address pre-computed from a salt is the address that actually gets deployed. On the frontend, you will follow a signed operation from the client's RPC call through the bundler to finality, and prove it landed, failed or reverted the way it should. You will fork the chain to test against real state, deploy and call contracts from the command line, and turn what you learn into automated suites. You will work in a small, senior engineering team alongside an external wallet-infrastructure partner. You can tell a defect in our code from one in a partner SDK or in the chain itself — and you bring the evidence to show which. AI coding tools are part of how you work every day, and you set them up so the rest of the team gets the same leverage.

This is a hands-on, partner-facing engineering role. You'll spend your time troubleshooting real integration problems, reproducing and routing defects, and protecting our development teams from being pulled off their roadmaps for questions you can answer or resolve yourself. You'll work closely with Customer Success, Tech Leads, Directors of Engineering, Product Owners, and QA — and you'll be the connective tissue that keeps all of them in sync on behalf of the partner.

jobs.title: Staff Software Engineer Smart Wallet & Account Abstraction
jobs.description_text: About Xsolla Xsolla is a global commerce company with robust tools and services to help developers solve the inherent challenges of the video game industry. About the Role We're looking for a Staff Engineer to own the smart wallet and account abstraction layer of Xsolla's Web3 platform. This is an individual contributor role with outsized technical scope: you'll be the technical anchor for how millions of players get an on-chain account they never have to think about — setting direction, making hard architectural calls, and raising the bar across the org. Concretely, you'll own the account model behind Xsolla ZK, our zkSync-based L2, and the wallet that sits inside Xsolla App. Every player who signs in with Xsolla ID receives a deterministic, non-custodial smart account — derived from their identity claim, identical on every device, with private keys that never leave the client. That account is not a separate "wallet" screen: it is the player's inventory, and it backs minting, gifting, trading on our Bazaar marketplace, Merkle-based reward airdrops, gas sponsorship, and an in-app dApp browser that exposes the same signer to third-party applications through an EIP-1193 provider. You'll own the primitives underneath all of it: the ERC-4337 user operation lifecycle, EIP-7702 delegation, session keys and origin-bound Smart Sessions, paymaster and gas abstraction strategy, and the custody and recovery roadmap — including the move from raw key export to MPC custody. Data Science is at the heart of Lyft’s products and decision-making. You will leverage data and rigorous, analytical thinking to shape our mapping products and make business decisions that put our customers first. This will involve identifying and scoping opportunities, shaping priorities, recommending technical solutions, designing experiments, and measuring the impact of new features. You will help us solve some of the most impactful problems in mapping, including: How do we improve the quality of our map data in order to improve our recommendations? How do we benchmark and measure the success of our services? How do we validate features of the real world that affect our routing algorithms? Are we meeting our travel estimation promises to our customers? Our work centers on four pillars: AD/ADAS, our autonomous driving and advanced driver assist technologies; Arene, our software development platform for software-defined vehicles; Woven City, a test course for mobility; and Cloud & AI, the digital infrastructure powering our collaborative foundation. Business-critical functions empower these teams to execute, and together, we’re working toward one bold goal: a world with zero accidents and enhanced well-being for all. =========================================================================

jobs.title: Account Executive
jobs.description_text: Company at a Glance OpenX is focused on unleashing the full economic potential of digital media companies. We do this by making digital advertising markets and technologies that are designed to deliver optimal value to publishers and advertisers on every ad served across all screens. At OpenX, we have built a team that is uniquely experienced in designing and operating high-scale ad marketplaces, and we are constantly on the lookout for thoughtful, creative executors who are as fascinated as we are about finding new ways to apply a blend of market design, technical innovation, operational excellence, and empathetic partner service to the frontiers of digital advertising.

jobs.title: Buyer Development Sr Director DACH
jobs.description_text: OpenX is looking for a senior, commercially driven Buyer Development leader to establish and grow our demand-side business across DACH. This is the first dedicated Buyer Development role in-market. The role will be directly responsible for generating revenue across agencies, holdcos, and clients / brands, building senior relationships and commercial foundations required for long-term growth. The successful candidate will open senior buyer relationships, build and manage pipeline, progress strategic opportunities, and convert demand-side engagement into measurable revenue outcomes. This is a senior individual contributor role to begin with. As the DACH opportunity matures, the ambition is for this person to help build and potentially lead a broader regional Buyer Development function once clear market proof points have been established.

jobs.title: Director, Growth Marketing

jobs.title: Global Head of Customer Success Engineering
jobs.description_text: OpenX is hiring a Global Head of Customer Success Engineering (CSE) with significant technical & business operations experience in the programmatic ecosystem to join our Commercial Operations leadership team. You will manage OpenX’s Solutions Architects, Support Engineering, and Deal Operations organizations, and will act as the technical backbone behind our customer-facing partners, including publishers, DSPs, and strategic partners. You will be building world class teams to drive revenue, maximize integration health, and act as the client facing technical expert and thought leader. The role will report directly to the VP, Commercial Operations. We want someone who is deeply technical, highly strategic and business-oriented, and strives to raise the bar across the entire business through thoughtful leadership, critical thinking, and heavy collaboration. You will be a player-coach, with a deep technical understanding of the programmatic SSP landscape with a strong expertise in publisher & DSP OpenRTB integrations across all programmatic channels. You will work closely with almost all OpenX teams, including sales, account management, product, engineering, and legal, as well as directly with our partners. You should be an expert in identifying technical challenges, limitations, troubleshooting, and providing solutions that drive revenue for our partners. A proven track record of managing technical teams and achieving targets is required.

jobs.title: Minor League Strength & Conditioning Coach (AA – Richmond)
jobs.description_text: Position: Minor League Strength & Conditioning Coach (AA – Richmond) Reports To: Director of Strength & Conditioning, Coordinator of Strength & Conditioning, Director of Minor League Medical. Department: Medical/ Player Development Status: Full Time; Exempt Position Summary: The San Francisco Giants are seeking a full-time Minor-League Strength & Conditioning Coach to join the Baseball Operations team. This role will have primary responsibilities for the implementation of Strength & Conditioning protocols with the AA Richmond affiliated team within the Giants Organization. Position Responsibilities: Implementation and supervision of organization’s Strength & Conditioning protocols. Prescribe and teach individualized athletic development program based on athlete’s ongoing physical assessments throughout the year. Execution of weight room training programs for strength, power, and speed development.
